name: Fungal Vale
summary: In Fungal Vale, Scourge horrors roam beneath a murky haze, and Cult of the Damned acolytes serve among the fungi. The vale lies in south-central Eastern Plaguelands, north of Crown Guard Tower and Marris Stead.

sections.title: A Garden of Rot
sections.body: North of Marris Stead, Fungal Vale lies among Lordaeron’s most corrupted places. Sickly purple earth swells with alien fungi beneath a haze of necrotic spores. The Plague of Undeath has warped the soil, raising unholy growths that feed carrion beasts and shambling undead. Members of the Cult of the Damned tend the blighted blooms and perform foul rites amid the decay.

faq.answer: Fungal Vale is a corrupted valley in the southern Eastern Plaguelands, north of Crown Guard Tower and Marris Stead. The Plague of Undeath has blighted the land and turned ordinary vegetation into sprawling fungal growths.

faq.q: Why is the ground purple here?
faq.answer: The Plague of Undeath has saturated the soil with necrotic power. It twists the land into ground fertile with virulent spores and stains the earth a bruised purple.
Scourge horrors and mortal cultists of the Cult of the Damned hold Fungal Vale. Undead wander through the haze while acolytes tend its corrupted fungi.

faq.q: Where is it located relative to local landmarks?
aliases: how to get to fungal vale
faq.answer: Fungal Vale lies in south-central Eastern Plaguelands, north of the road between Marris Stead and Crown Guard Tower.

angles.text: As a druid, you see nature’s cycle mocked in Fungal Vale, where the Scourge have replaced life with unending, unholy rot.
As a herbalist, you see necromancy blighting Lordaeron’s native plants and choking the ground with fungi.
